scripts.build:web: npm run debuffs:generate && love.js game/ dist/web -c -t "Pixel Card Game"
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run preview:prepare && vite --config editor/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:editor: npm run build:web && npm run preview:prepare && vite build --config editor/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:editor: npm run debuffs:check && node --test tools/generate-debuffs.test.mjs && vitest run --config editor/vite.config.ts
